[icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] is an important yield when managing your empire. Each [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP] independently earns [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] based on the Appeal of each improved tile, any [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Buildings[/TIP] constructed, [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]Resources[/TIP] assigned, and other factors. The Settlement’s [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MAINTENANCE_TOOLTIP]Maintenance[/TIP] is then deducted, resulting in the Settlement’s final [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] yield.[nn]If the yield is positive, the Settlement is considered Happy and any excess yield is used toward generating your next [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CELEBRATIONS_TOOLTIP]Celebration[/TIP].[nn]If the yield is negative, the Settlement is considered Unhappy and suffers penalties. For each point of unhappiness, the Settlement receives a 3% penalty on applicable yields, with a maximum penalty of 40%.[nn]The most common cost of [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] is Maintenance from Buildings and [icon:SPECIALIST][TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SPECIALIST_TOOLTIP]Specialists[/TIP]. As you consider how to improve your Settlement’s infrastructure, pay attention to the [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] costs you’re introducing. Balancing [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] Maintenance with making your Settlements more productive is an important skill in the game.[nn]Your empire’s [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_LIMIT_TOOLTIP]Settlement Limit[/TIP] also plays an important role in [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b]. For each Settlement you are over the Settlement Limit, every Settlement receives a stacking -5 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b]. This can add up quickly, so it’s important to manage your [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] well if you go over your limit!

[icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] measures your people's satisfaction with you.[n]You can earn [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] by settling near fresh water, assigning [icon:RADIAL_RESOURCES][TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]Resources[/TIP] that grant [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b], and constructing [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Buildings[/TIP] and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WONDERS_TOOLTIP]Wonders[/TIP]. Excess [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] from your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] goes to your Empire every turn; once enough excess [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] is accrued, you earn a [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CELEBRATIONS_TOOLTIP]Celebration[/TIP]![n]Settlements also have sources of negative [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b], usually from maintaining Buildings or Specialists. A Settlement becomes [b]Unhappy[/b] when it requires more Happiness than it creates, and will receive yield penalties: [b]-3% in applicable yields for every point below 0 Happiness, up to -40%[/b]. Poor Settlement management and ongoing Wars can also reduce [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] in Settlements.[n]Don't fret, your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ADVISOR_TOOLTIP]Advisors[/TIP] are here to monitor your [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS][b]Happiness[/b] and alert you of any issues.
